title: Privacy Policy
body:
# Privacy Policy

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

BQ SQWAD TV ("we", "us") lets you watch films and channels online and pay only for the time you watch. This policy explains what information we collect, why we use it, who we share it with, and the choices you have. Contact us at tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 1. Information we collect
**Account information.** Email address, name or display name, protected sign-in information, date of birth and selected country. We use date of birth to apply age restrictions.

**Wallet and payment information.** Wallet balance, top-ups, charges and receipts. Payment providers for the website and Android handle card and bank details. We do not receive or store your full card number.

**Viewing information.** Titles watched, when and for how long, applicable price, currency, playback position, connection signals and a device identifier. We keep the history needed to explain charges and provide account features.

**Device and security information.** Device type, app version, approximate country derived from IP address, sign-ins, failed attempts and device registrations.

**Ratings, comments and messages.** Ratings and comments you submit, displayed with your chosen display name after moderation, and messages sent to us through the contact form or tv@bqsqwad.com.

**Producer and provider information.** If you apply to supply content or channels, we may collect identity and business details, rights evidence, licence dates and territories, payout details, tax details, contract information and submitted content.

## 2. How we use information
- Create and secure accounts and keep users signed in.
- Apply age, territory, publication and rights rules.
- Measure billable viewing time, charge wallets accurately, issue receipts and prevent duplicate charges.
- Process confirmed payments, top-ups and supported reversals or refunds.
- Calculate producer or provider shares under the applicable terms and contract.
- Moderate comments, prevent abuse, detect fraud and protect the service.
- Show advertising where configured and permitted.
- Send receipts, security alerts, policy changes and service messages.
- Measure service performance, fix problems and meet legal obligations.

## 3. Legal grounds
Depending on the country, we rely on performing our agreement, legitimate interests such as security and fraud prevention, consent where required, and legal obligations.

## 4. Sharing
We share information only as needed with payment partners, hosting and storage providers, email and notification providers, advertising partners where ads are shown, professional advisers and authorities where required by law. Producers and providers receive only the information and aggregated performance figures needed for their work, not viewer identities or wallet details. We do not sell personal information.

## 5. Advertising
We may show ads in the app or website and in approved breaks where configured. Ads must follow age and territory rules. Before an advertising partner uses device identifiers where consent or notice is required, we will provide the applicable partner information and choices.

## 6. Age and children
Adult-only channels are available only to viewers who meet the applicable legal age and complete the required verification. People under {{minimum_age}} may not create an account. If you believe a child below that age has provided information, contact tv@bqsqwad.com so we can review and take appropriate action.

## 7. Cookies and similar technologies
We use technologies needed to sign users in, protect sessions and remember settings. Any optional cookies or similar technologies will be described with the choices available in the relevant notice.

## 8. Retention
Account and wallet records are kept while an account is open and afterwards for periods required by law. Viewing history is kept for {{viewing_history_retention}}. Producer or provider identity evidence is kept for {{evidence_retention}} after a decision. Security records are kept for {{security_log_retention}}. We then delete or anonymise information unless a legal or security reason requires longer retention.

## 9. International processing
Our service providers may process information in countries other than yours. Where required, we use appropriate contractual or other legal safeguards.

## 10. Security
We use safeguards such as encryption in transit, restricted access and audit records. No system is perfectly secure. Use a strong, unique password and contact us promptly if you suspect misuse.

## 11. Your rights and choices
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or export information, object to or restrict some uses, withdraw consent and complain to a data protection authority. Use your account settings or contact tv@bqsqwad.com. We may retain limited financial records where the law requires it.

## 12. Changes
We may update this policy. For significant changes, we will notify users and request renewed acceptance where required. The dates above show when the policy was updated.

## 13. Contact
BQ SQWAD TV
Email: tv@bqsqwad.com
{{postal_address_if_required}}

title: Terms and Conditions
body:
# Terms and Conditions

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

These terms are an agreement between you and BQ SQWAD TV ("we", "us"). By creating an account or watching, you accept these terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not accept them, do not use the service. Contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 1. The service
We provide online viewing of films, programmes and channels on our website and Android app. Viewing is online only. You may not record, copy or redistribute what you watch.

## 2. Your account
You must provide accurate information, be at least {{minimum_age}} years old, and keep sign-in details private. We may limit registered devices and simultaneous sessions. Tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorised use.

## 3. Pay as you go
- Each title or channel displays its price per minute in your wallet currency before viewing.
- Charges are calculated from eligible viewing time by the second. Partial minutes are not rounded up to a full minute.
- You need enough available wallet balance. Playback may stop when your balance or daily limit is reached. A temporary hold may be placed during a session and released or settled under the displayed rules.
- Paused, buffering and non-playing time is not intended to be charged. If you dispute a charge, contact us within {{dispute_window_days}} days for review.
- Your wallet currency follows your selected country. We do not silently convert wallet balances. Country and currency changes are allowed only when balance and holds are zero.
- Price changes apply to new sessions; an existing session uses its saved price.

## 4. Wallet and payments
Top-ups are processed by payment partners and added only after confirmation. {{wallet_refund_rule}} Wallet balances are for viewing on BQ SQWAD TV and are not transferable. We may reverse a credit when a payment fails, is disputed or is confirmed fraudulent.

## 5. Age and ratings
Content ratings are shown before playback. Where a device supports spoken announcements, a rating may also be announced. Adult-only channels are hidden from and unavailable to anyone who is not verified as an adult. Parents and guardians should supervise younger viewers.

## 6. Ratings and comments
Eligible viewers may rate titles and submit comments. Comments may be reviewed before publication. Do not submit unlawful, hateful, threatening, exploitative, misleading, private or spam content. We may remove content and restrict accounts for breaches. You retain ownership of your writing and give us permission to display it on the service. There is no viewer-to-viewer private messaging.

## 7. Acceptable use
Do not share or sell account access, use bots or scrapers, bypass payment, age, territory or security controls, record or redistribute streams, attack the service or harm other users.

## 8. Content and viewing permission
Content and software belong to us or our licensors. We grant a personal, limited, non-transferable right to watch on your devices while your account is in good standing. Availability depends on rights, territory, platform and licence dates.

## 9. Availability
We aim to keep the service available but cannot promise uninterrupted operation. Busy periods, maintenance or licence changes may delay, restrict or remove content.

## 10. Suspension and account closure
We may suspend or close accounts for legal, safety, security or terms-related reasons. You may request account closure in settings. Treatment of unused balance on closure: {{closure_balance_rule}}.

## 11. Liability
We do not exclude liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. To the extent permitted by law, indirect or consequential loss is excluded and the total liability limit is the amount paid to us in the {{liability_period_months}} months before the claim.

## 12. Changes
We may update these terms. We will notify users of significant changes and request renewed acceptance where required.

## 13. Law and disputes
These terms are governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}. Disputes are handled by the courts of {{jurisdiction}}, subject to mandatory consumer rights. Please contact tv@bqsqwad.com first.

## 14. Contact
BQ SQWAD TV — tv@bqsqwad.com

title: Producer Terms and Conditions
body:
# Producer Terms and Conditions

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

These terms apply to individuals, companies and teams ("you", "producer") applying to supply content to BQ SQWAD TV ("we", "us"). They supplement our Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy. Contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 1. Application and verification
You must complete identity and business checks before content can be published or payouts requested. Uploading a document does not mean it has been accepted. We may request more evidence, refuse an application or suspend or revoke approval with a recorded reason. You cannot approve your own verification or content.

## 2. Rights and warranties
You confirm that you own or have written authority to distribute each submission for the declared territories, platforms and dates; that it does not infringe rights or break the law; and that your information is accurate. Tell us promptly if a licence changes, expires or is disputed. You grant us the non-exclusive rights needed to host, process, promote, display and deliver approved content during the agreed licence period and territories.

## 3. Review and publication
Submission does not guarantee publication. We review rights, ratings, safety, quality and metadata. We may approve, reject, request changes, suspend or remove content. Only our authorised publishing process can publish content.

## 4. Ratings, territories and prices
Provide accurate ratings and territory details. We may correct ratings or availability. We set viewer prices and any limits; proposed prices do not take effect until approved.

## 5. Revenue share and payouts
Viewers pay by the second. Your share is the approved percentage for the title or channel applied to eligible settled viewing revenue using the basis shown in your statement: {{revenue_basis}}. Changes apply prospectively after {{revenue_change_notice_days}} days' notice. Statements are separated by currency; currencies are not added together without a clearly labelled reporting currency and dated rate. Payout requests are reviewed and, when approved, paid to your verified payout details subject to a minimum of {{minimum_payout}}. Refunds, disputes, chargebacks, fraud or rights issues may affect amounts. You are responsible for taxes.

## 6. Teams and confidentiality
You may assign roles within your own organisation. You are responsible for team activity. Team access does not grant access to our internal controls or another producer's data. Keep console access confidential. Viewer information is aggregated; do not attempt to identify viewers.

## 7. Content standards and takedowns
Follow the Producer Content Policy. Provide accurate rights evidence. We may suspend or remove content and pause related earnings when rights, safety or legal concerns arise. Send rights claims to tv@bqsqwad.com. Repeat or serious breaches may lead to account closure.

## 8. Liability and indemnity
You are responsible for your submissions and promises. To the extent permitted by law, you will cover losses caused by your breach or infringing content. Any agreed liability limit is {{liability_period_months}} months of earnings before the claim, except where law prohibits a limit.

## 9. Ending
You may stop supplying content. We may suspend or end access for breach, risk or legal reasons. Verified amounts properly due remain subject to review and the payout process. Retention follows the licence and legal requirements.

## 10. Changes, law and contact
We may update these terms with notice. They are governed by {{governing_law}} and disputes are handled by courts in {{jurisdiction}}, subject to mandatory law. Contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

title: Producer Content Policy
body:
# Producer Content Policy

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

This policy sets standards for content submitted to BQ SQWAD TV ("we", "us"). We may refuse, restrict or remove content that breaks it. Contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 1. Rights first
Submit only content you may lawfully distribute. Supply the owner or licensor, licence start and end dates, territories, platforms and restrictions. Keep supporting evidence available. Expired, unclear or disputed rights mean content cannot be published or must be removed.

## 2. Content we do not accept
- Illegal content.
- Sexual content involving minors or exploitative material.
- Real sexual violence or non-consensual sexual material.
- Content promoting terrorism, violent extremism or direct harm.
- Hate speech or targeted harassment.
- Pirated, leaked, stolen or unauthorised material.
- Misleading titles, artwork, descriptions or ratings, spam or undisclosed advertising.
- Malicious files or attempts to harm viewers, devices or our service.
- Private personal information shared without a lawful basis or consent.

## 3. Ratings and adult content
Give every title an honest age rating using the rating choices provided. Violence, nudity, language, drug use and frightening scenes may affect a rating. Adult-only material may be submitted only for channels approved for adults and subject to required verification. We may change a rating or restrict a title.

## 4. Quality and metadata
Provide an accurate title, synopsis, genre, language, cast and credits, duration, available captions and artwork you have rights to use. Artwork must be suitable for the channel's audience. We may correct metadata for accuracy or safety.

## 5. Files and promotion
Submit clean files in accepted formats and sizes. Do not embed hidden code, tracking or unauthorised links. Do not insert advertising or sponsor messages without written approval.

## 6. Enforcement and appeals
We may request changes, hold publication, remove content, pause disputed earnings, suspend uploads or close an account. You may reply through your producer console or contact tv@bqsqwad.com for review.

## 7. Reporting
Report rights or policy concerns to tv@bqsqwad.com with the title and relevant details.

title: Licensed Channel Provider Terms
body:
# Licensed Channel Provider Terms

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

These terms apply to a provider supplying licensed channels or programmes to BQ SQWAD TV ("we", "us"). They operate together with the signed provider contract and applicable platform terms. Contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 1. Provider authority and warranties
You confirm that you are authorised to grant the rights stated in the contract and that all channel, programme, artwork and schedule information is accurate. You warrant that the rights cover the agreed countries, platforms, audience ratings and licence dates. Notify us immediately of any restriction, claim, expiry or change.

## 2. Licence and delivery
The signed contract identifies the channels, territories, platforms, licence window, permitted playback method and any technical conditions. You remain responsible for the provider-delivered service and its credentials. We will not claim a delivery or rights capability that is not enabled and tested. No rights are granted outside the written contract.

## 3. Revenue model and statements
Each channel uses exactly the revenue model recorded in its contract. Where the contract specifies a gross-profit share, gross profit is eligible revenue less only the deductible cost categories and allocation rules expressly listed in that contract. Your provider share is the agreed percentage of that gross profit, calculated separately for each currency. Statements identify revenue, permitted deductions, adjustments, gross profit, share and currency. Estimates for an open period are not final amounts. Different currencies are not combined unless both the reporting currency and dated conversion rate are shown.

## 4. Settlement and disputes
A statement becomes payable only under the contract and after the required review and approval. A payment is marked paid only after its actual payment reference is recorded. If you dispute a statement or adjustment, submit the period, amount, currency and reason through the provider console. We will review it and record the outcome. A disputed amount may remain on hold while reviewed.

## 5. Takedowns and service protection
We may suspend a channel or delivery grant immediately where rights expire, a territory or platform is not authorised, credentials are compromised, a legal notice is received or service safety requires it. We will notify you where lawful and practical. You must cooperate with rights checks and takedown requests.

## 6. Confidentiality and information
Keep credentials, contract terms and non-public service information confidential. Use viewer or performance information only for the contract purpose. You must not attempt to identify viewers or access another provider's information.

## 7. Compliance and responsibility
You are responsible for applicable licences, permissions, taxes and legal compliance for the content and service you supply. You must keep supporting evidence and provide it when reasonably requested.

## 8. Termination
Either party may terminate as stated in the signed contract. We may suspend or terminate access for material breach, loss of rights, security risk or legal requirement. On termination, playback rights end as stated in the contract and final statements are prepared subject to unresolved disputes and lawful retention.

## 9. Changes and contact
The signed contract controls commercial terms where it differs from this general document. Changes to these terms will be notified and recorded. Contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

title: Cookie and Tracking Notice
body:
# Cookie and Tracking Notice

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

This notice explains how BQ SQWAD TV and BQ Sqwad Technologies ("we", "us") use cookies and similar technologies across our website and applications. Contact us at tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 1. What Are Cookies?
Cookies and local storage are small text or data files stored on your browser or device when you use online services. They allow our platform to recognize your session and keep your account secure.

## 2. Technologies We Use
- **Strictly Necessary Cookies:** Essential for signing in, maintaining session security, preventing cross-site request forgery, and processing wallet transactions.
- **Functional Storage:** Remembers your appearance preference (light or dark mode) and chosen language.
- **Performance and Reliability:** Anonymous diagnostic beacons used to detect playback errors, network stalls, and service outages.

## 3. Advertising and Third Parties
Where advertising is shown, third-party advertising partners may use non-personalized identifiers in compliance with applicable privacy regulations. We do not sell your personal data.

## 4. Managing Your Preferences
You can configure your browser to block or alert you about cookies. Disabling strictly necessary cookies will prevent you from signing in to your account.

## 5. Contact
BQ SQWAD TV — BQ Sqwad Technologies
Email: tv@bqsqwad.com

title: About BQ SQWAD TV
body:
# About BQ SQWAD TV

BQ SQWAD TV is a premium digital streaming entertainment platform operated by BQ Sqwad Technologies. Entertainment without limits — watch, stream, and enjoy premium films, series, sports, and live television with true pay-as-you-go freedom.

## Our Mission
We believe viewers should pay only for what they actually watch. With transparent second-by-second wallet metering, you are never locked into wasteful monthly subscriptions you don't use.

## For Creators and Channel Providers
Our platform empowers independent producers, studios, and licensed broadcast channels with powerful digital consoles, transparent real-time revenue sharing, and global reach across web and mobile ecosystems.

## Global Infrastructure
Operated with modern high-speed edge delivery networks, robust media delivery, and secure payment processing through our payment providers.

## Corporate Information
BQ SQWAD TV is operated by BQ Sqwad Technologies.
Contact: tv@bqsqwad.com

title: Help & Support
body:
# Help & Support Centre

Welcome to the BQ SQWAD TV Help Centre. Find quick answers to common questions about your account, wallet, playback, and streaming experience.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does pay-as-you-go billing work?
You top up your digital wallet and stream any title or live channel. Charges are calculated strictly based on eligible watched seconds at the displayed per-minute rate. When you pause or stop, charging stops immediately.

### Wallet top-ups
Visit My Wallet in your account hub. Available payment methods are shown at checkout on the website and in the Android app.

### Changing wallet currency
Your wallet currency is established based on your registered country. To protect balance integrity, wallet currency cannot be altered once transactions exist.

### What if a stream buffers or fails to load?
Our player automatically retries and switches quality profiles. You are not billed for buffering or non-playing periods. If you notice any discrepancy, reach out to our team.

## Contact Support
For direct help, email **tv@bqsqwad.com** with the account email and details of the request.

title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
body:
# Refund and Cancellation Policy

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

This Refund and Cancellation Policy applies to digital wallet top-ups and streaming charges on BQ SQWAD TV (operated by BQ Sqwad Technologies). Contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 1. Pay-As-You-Go Billing Model
BQ SQWAD TV operates on a pay-per-second model. Because you are charged only for actual streamed viewing time, completed viewing sessions are generally non-refundable.

## 2. Unused Wallet Top-Ups
If you top up your digital wallet by mistake and have not used any of the top-up balance, you may request a refund within 14 calendar days of the transaction date. Payment processing partner fees may be deducted where permitted by applicable law.

## 3. Disputed Viewing Charges
If technical errors (such as verifiable audio desync, corrupted video streams, or system outages) cause an incorrect wallet deduction, submit a dispute within 30 days of the session via your account transactions or to tv@bqsqwad.com. Verified erroneous deductions will be credited back to your wallet balance.

## 4. Account Closure
Upon verified account closure, any unused non-promotional real-currency balance may be refunded to the original payment method upon request, subject to security verification and processing fees.

## 5. Submitting a Request
To request a refund or dispute a charge, email tv@bqsqwad.com with your account email, payment receipt, and detailed reason.

title: Community Guidelines
body:
# Community Guidelines

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

BQ SQWAD TV brings viewers, creators, and fans together. These guidelines ensure our comments, ratings, and community features remain respectful, enjoyable, and safe for everyone.

## 1. Respect and Civility
- Treat fellow viewers and creators with courtesy.
- Constructive reviews and critical opinions of programmes are welcome; personal attacks, hate speech, harassment, and bullying are strictly prohibited.

## 2. Prohibited Content
Do not submit comments or profile information that contains:
- Hate speech, slurs, or discriminatory attacks targeting race, ethnicity, religion, disability, age, nationality, or sexual orientation.
- Explicit sexual content or graphic violence.
- Defamatory, libelous, or knowingly false statements.
- Spam, automated posts, phishing links, or unsolicited advertising.
- Private personal data of any individual without authorization.

## 3. Moderation and Enforcement
All public comments are subject to automated filtering and human moderation. Breaches may lead to comment removal, suspension of commenting privileges, or permanent account restriction.

## 4. Reporting Violations
To report abusive comments or violations, email tv@bqsqwad.com with the title name and details.

title: Copyright & DMCA Policy
body:
# Copyright & DMCA Policy

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

BQ Sqwad Technologies respects the intellectual property rights of others and requires all producers and channel providers to hold verified distribution rights for content hosted on BQ SQWAD TV.

## 1. Copyright Notification
If you believe in good faith that any content hosted on BQ SQWAD TV infringes your copyright, send a written notice containing:
- Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to have been infringed.
- Identification of the material on BQ SQWAD TV claimed to be infringing, with sufficient URL/title details.
- Your contact details (name, address, telephone, email address).
- A statement that you have a good-faith belief that the disputed use is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
- A statement made under penalty of perjury that the information in the notification is accurate and that you are authorized to act on behalf of the owner.
- Your physical or electronic signature.

## 2. Designated Agent Contact
**Designated Copyright Agent:**
BQ Sqwad Technologies — Legal & Rights Compliance
Email: tv@bqsqwad.com
Subject: Copyright or rights notice

## 3. Counter-Notification & Repeat Infringers
Producers may submit a formal counter-notification if they believe material was removed in error. In accordance with applicable laws, BQ SQWAD TV terminates accounts of repeat copyright infringers.

title: Producer Privacy Notice
body:
# Producer Privacy Notice

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

This notice explains how BQ Sqwad Technologies processes information when you register as a producer, manage a channel, submit content, receive payments or contact the BQ SQWAD TV team.

## 1. Information we process
- Account and contact details, including your name, email address, country and account security records.
- Producer and channel information, roles, permissions, upload history and account status.
- Content metadata, age ratings, ownership declarations, copyright declarations, licences and rights evidence you submit.
- Payment, payout and tax-related records needed to verify and reconcile producer earnings. Card and bank credentials are handled by the relevant payment provider; do not submit passwords or secret credentials to BQ SQWAD TV.
- Technical, security and service-usage records needed to operate uploads, playback, moderation, fraud prevention and support.

## 2. Why we use this information
We use producer information to operate your account and channel, process and review uploads, verify distribution rights, apply age and territory restrictions, calculate and reconcile amounts under your accepted producer agreement, protect the service, respond to reports and meet applicable legal obligations.

## 3. Sharing and service providers
Information is shared only with authorised personnel and service providers where needed for hosting, storage, video processing, authentication, payment processing, security, support or legal compliance. We do not publish private rights evidence, identity documents, payout details or account security information.

## 4. Public content and copyright claims
Titles, descriptions, approved artwork and published videos may be visible to viewers. Private source files, draft uploads, rights evidence and contact details remain restricted. A copyright report may be shared with the producer to investigate or respond to the claim, subject to applicable law.

## 5. Retention
Producer information is retained only for the period needed for the purposes above and applicable legal, accounting, dispute and security requirements. The approved producer-specific retention schedule is: {{producer_data_retention}}. Do not publish this notice until this setting has been confirmed.

## 6. Access, correction and deletion
You may request access to or correction of producer account information and may request account closure through the producer console or tv@bqsqwad.com. Some records may need to be retained where required for payments, disputes, fraud prevention or legal compliance.

## 7. Security and confidentiality
Use your own account, protect sign-in credentials and do not share private account or rights-management information. Report suspected unauthorised access to tv@bqsqwad.com.

## 8. Contact
For privacy questions or requests, contact tv@bqsqwad.com.

title: Provider Privacy Notice
body:
# Provider Privacy Notice

Effective date: {{effective_date}}
Last updated: {{last_updated}}

This notice explains how BQ Sqwad Technologies processes information about business channel providers and their authorised representatives when they apply to operate channels, submit programme information, manage schedules, request approvals, receive statements or contact BQ SQWAD TV. It supplements the general Privacy Policy and the signed provider agreement. Contact tv@bqsqwad.com for privacy requests.

## 1. Information we process
We may process business identity and registration details, business contact information, authorised representative details, verification results, channel and programme metadata, schedules, stream-source and technical diagnostics, rights and licence evidence, territories, contract records, account roles, security events, statements, payment and tax records, and support communications. Identity documents, private stream access details, bank details and confidential contracts are restricted to authorised personnel and service providers who need them for a defined purpose.

## 2. Purposes
We use this information to verify the provider and its authority, establish and administer channel agreements, validate rights and territories, review and approve channel or live-stream submissions, operate and secure technical integrations, prepare statements, reconcile payments, investigate complaints, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations.

## 3. Legal grounds
Depending on applicable law and the context, processing is based on steps requested before entering a contract, performance of the provider agreement, legal obligations, legitimate interests in platform security and rights compliance, or consent where required. Where we rely on consent, it may be withdrawn subject to lawful limitations.

## 4. Sharing and confidentiality
Information may be shared with authorised BQ SQWAD TV personnel, verification providers, hosting and storage providers, payment and accounting partners, security and technical service providers, professional advisers and public authorities where legally required. We do not sell personal information. We do not publish private credentials, identity documents, payout details or confidential contract materials. Provider-facing access is limited by role and business relationship.

## 5. Channel content and public information
Approved channel names, logos, schedules, programme descriptions and other authorised public metadata may be displayed to viewers. Private source URLs, access tokens, verification documents, internal moderation notes and non-public business contact details are not intended for public display. A rights complaint or moderation matter may require sharing relevant information with affected parties where lawful and necessary to investigate or respond.

## 6. Retention
We retain provider records for the period needed to administer the relationship, verify rights, maintain financial and audit records, resolve disputes, protect the service and comply with law. The final provider-specific retention schedule must be confirmed by the platform owner and qualified counsel before this notice is published: {{provider_data_retention}}.

## 7. International processing and security
Service providers may process information in other countries. Where required, appropriate contractual or other safeguards will be used. We apply access controls, secure transmission and audit records appropriate to the information, but no online service can guarantee absolute security. Providers must protect their credentials and promptly report suspected compromise.

## 8. Rights and requests
Depending on location, individuals may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to certain processing, request portability, withdraw consent or complain to a data protection authority. Requests may be sent to tv@bqsqwad.com. We may need to verify identity and retain limited records where required by law or needed to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

## 9. Changes
We may update this notice and will provide notice or seek renewed acceptance where required. The effective date and version of the published notice will be displayed with it.

## 10. Contact
BQ Sqwad Technologies — BQ SQWAD TV
Email: tv@bqsqwad.com
